description:
We are a family team inspired and led by our 15-year-old aspiring rocket scientist studying grade 9. Our team includes his mother-a Lead Software Engineer,his cousin brother-2nd year Computer Science undergraduate, and the young innovator himself who always speaks about space science and dreams to become rocket scientist.We aim to build an interactive Space Mission Design Game combining coding,creativity and space science. 

We are not here to just participate, We are very serious about winning!
